digest.component_or_area: CLI-served author guides and documentation references
propositions: Clients running the rebar CLI without a local repo checkout cannot resolve internal cross-references in packaged guides because they use consumer-relative paths like review-policy.md and ../CONTRIBUTING.md
The commit-trailer format (EXPECTED_FORMAT in verify_commit.py) lacks a first-class CLI-discoverable home; it is only documented in rebar verify-commit-ticket --help help text

All cross-references in packaged _guides/*.md files must be converted to use hosted https:// URLs for repo-only docs and rebar explain <topic> for sibling guides to ensure repo-less clients can resolve them

A new packaged guide src/rebar/_guides/commit-ticket-trailer.md must be created, registered in AUTHOR_GUIDES, and served by rebar explain commit-trailer to provide offline discovery of the trailer format
A link-resolution guard test must enforce that no packaged guide contains consumer-relative paths, ensuring the remediation remains comprehensive across future changes
